_source: NPSA grant-knowledge Drive folder, states/*.yaml (Shared drives > NPSA Shared Files > Claude Context (Do Not Modify) > Projects/Operations/grant-knowledge).
_regenerate: These files are the source of truth and are maintained with their own last_verified dates. When they change, re-extract rather than editing this file by hand.
_confidence: confirmed = the state file states the date plainly. illustrative = the file itself flags it 'verify each cycle', or it is recorded as a note on a past window rather than as a fixed deadline. Only confirmed dates are presented as confirmed to a rep.

state_programs.name: Louisiana Center for Safe Schools Grant Program
state_programs.note: SCHOOLS ONLY — PreK/K-12 instruction. Not a general nonprofit security program, so do not offer it to a church without a school.

state_programs.name: Protecting Against Hate Crimes
state_programs.note: Administered by the Governor's Office of Crime Prevention and Policy, NOT MDEM. ~$10M FY26/27. Capital/IT requests over $200k not considered.

state_programs.name: Commonwealth Nonprofit Security Grant Program
state_programs.note: $10k–$100k per site, ~$4.465M FY26. Equipment and physical security.

state_programs.name: Commonwealth Nonprofit Security Personnel Grant Program
state_programs.note: Funds CONTRACTED security personnel rather than equipment — a separate track from CNSGP.

MI.saa: Michigan State Police, Emergency Management and Homeland Security Division (MSP/EMHSD)

deadlines.note: 11:59pm ET. Online form only — email submissions are not accepted. Must use the FY2026 IJ template.
FY25 recorded as an application-window note.

MN.saa: Minnesota Department of Public Safety / Homeland Security and Emergency Management (HSEM)

state_programs.name: Minnesota Supplemental Nonprofit Security Grant Program
state_programs.note: AUTO-ELIGIBLE — the federal application is also considered for state funds, with no separate paperwork. $75,000 is a COMBINED federal + state cap per organization.

deadlines.note: 5:00pm CT. Late or incomplete submissions are not reviewed.

MO.saa: Missouri Department of Public Safety, Office of Homeland Security (OHS)
MO.note: Kansas-side KC UASI counties (Leavenworth, Wyandotte, Johnson) apply through Missouri, not Kansas.

deadlines.note: FY25 window closed 11:55pm.
FY2024 state cycle opened Jan 6, 2025, due Jan 31, 2025 5pm CST.

state_programs.name: Nebraska Nonprofit Security Grant Program
state_programs.note: Statutory $50k/org/year. INELIGIBLE if the org received a federal NSGP award in the previous 5 years — so this is an alternative to federal, not an addition.

NV.saa: Nevada Division of Emergency Management / Office of the Military (NV OEM)

state_programs.name: Nevada Nonprofit Security Grant Pilot Program (SB 413)
state_programs.note: $50k for equipment OR $10k for personnel — not both in the same fiscal year. $2M/yr for FY2025-26 and FY2026-27; may sunset after that.

NH.saa: New Hampshire Department of Safety — Bureau of Grants Management (Homeland Security)
NH.saa_correction: The tool's map said 'New Hampshire Division of Homeland Security & Emergency Management (HSEM)'; the SAA for NSGP is the DOS Bureau of Grants Management.

deadlines.note: FY25 due 4pm; FY24 was May 31 2024 noon — the window moves a lot in NH.

NH.note: NH caps at $150k per location and requires a 36-month local funding plan for any hired-security request.

NJ.saa: New Jersey Office of Homeland Security & Preparedness (NJOHSP)

deadlines.note: FY25 state window closed 11:59pm ET.

state_programs.name: NJ NSGP — Target Hardening Equipment
state_programs.note: Equipment only. M&A, training, exercise and planning are all disallowed.

state_programs.name: NJ NSGP — Security Personnel
state_programs.note: Contracted/registered security personnel only.

NJ.note: An org may APPLY to both NJ state programs but may receive only ONE state award per fiscal year.

state_programs.name: Nonprofit Security Grant Fund Program
state_programs.note: Administered by PCCD, not PEMA. $5,000 minimum. TIERED NON-STATE MATCH: none up to $25k, ~33% for $25,001-$75,000, ~50% above $75,000 — the only state program here with a match requirement.

deadlines.note: FY2025 RIEMA hard deadline, 5pm.

SC.saa_correction: NOT the South Carolina Emergency Management Division (SCEMD) — the tool's hardcoded map had this wrong.
SC.note: No self-service portal — SLED emails the forms on request. York and Lancaster counties fall inside NC's Charlotte UASI and apply through NCEM. The SC Pray Safe Act is NOT enacted, so there is no state program.

state_programs.name: Tennessee Houses of Worship Security Grant
state_programs.note: PERSONNEL ONLY — reimburses hours worked by TN POST-certified officers or licensed guards, not equipment. Cannot double-fund the same personnel cost as federal NSGP. Two-step registration gate with its own earlier deadline.
